summary: @ornikar/browserslist-config 8.0.9 preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated 727 KB payload
details: Version 8.0.9 of this package advertises itself as a browserslist configuration (the shipped main entry degraded-support.js is a ~200-byte static array of browser targets). Its package.json declares a preinstall script that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip (or reuses a locally installed bun) and then execFileSyncs bun against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727 KB heavily obfuscated file (obfuscator.io-style shuffled string-array with a rotator function and hex-named identifiers) whose contents are not statically reviewable. Prior versions of @ornikar/browserslist-config ship only the trivial static config files; the 8.0.9 tarball introduces the preinstall dropper and the obfuscated payload, consistent with a compromised publish. On npm install, an opaque payload executes under an alternate runtime outside Node's normal inspection surface, giving arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
